title: drag-lint Options
summary: The plugin's settings dialog for drag-lint: lets you browse and toggle the lint rule catalog
intro: Read this when you want to see which lint rules exist, which are on by default and which have an auto-fix, or to turn rules on and off. Open it from the drag-lint menu; it loads the catalog the same way as drag-lint rules --json.

steps: Browse the rule catalog (default state, auto-fix)

questions.ask: Which lint rules exist and which are on by default?
How do I turn lint rules on or off?
